examples.en: In our country, winter is cold.
I introduced our country's food to a foreign friend.
The autumn sky in our country is clear.
In our country, we take off our shoes when entering a house.
Delivery in our country is fast.
People in our country eat tteokguk on Seollal.

explain: '한국'은 나라 이름이고, '우리나라'는 한국 사람이 자기 나라를 말할 때 쓰는 말이에요. '우리'가 들어 있어서 가까운 느낌이 있어요. '우리 나라'로 띄어 쓰지 않고 한 단어로 붙여 써요.
explain_en: '한국' is the name of the country, while '우리나라' is what Koreans say when they talk about their own country. The word '우리' (our) gives it a close feeling. It is written as one word, not '우리 나라'.
